description: Defines the ProductAttribute class, an entity representing a product attribute with associated options and values in the catalog module.

classes.name: ProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing a product attribute, extending Entity and implementing Serializable, with references to ProductOption and ProductOptionValue.

methods.name: setOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the ProductOptionValue associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves the ProductOptionValue associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: setOption
methods.description: Sets the ProductOption associated with this product attribute.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves the ProductOption associated with this product attribute.
